description: This file defines several Kivy UI components related to multistroke settings, including containers, items, labels, boolean toggles, sliders, and a popup for editing settings. It also registers these components with the Kivy Factory.

classes.name: MultistrokeSettingsContainer
classes.description: A container class for multistroke settings, inherits from GridLayout.

classes.name: MultistrokeSettingItem
classes.description: A base class for individual setting items, includes title and description properties.

classes.name: MultistrokeSettingTitle
classes.description: A label class for setting titles, inherits from Label.

classes.name: MultistrokeSettingBoolean
classes.description: A boolean toggle setting, inherits from MultistrokeSettingItem, adds a button text and boolean value.

classes.name: MultistrokeSettingString
classes.description: A string input setting, inherits from MultistrokeSettingItem.

classes.name: EditSettingPopup
classes.description: A popup class for editing settings, includes an on_validate event.

classes.name: MultistrokeSettingSlider
classes.description: A slider setting with min, max, type, and value properties, includes methods for validation and touch handling.

methods.name: on_validate
methods.description: Event handler for validation, currently a placeholder.

methods.name: _to_numtype
methods.description: Converts a value to float or int based on the type property.

methods.name: _dismiss
methods.description: Dismisses the popup and unfocuses the input.

methods.name: _validate
methods.description: Validates and sets the slider value based on popup input.

methods.name: on_touch_down
methods.description: Handles touch events to open the slider popup.
